ctx.x: What if the teachers didn't sit down with you? They gave you books. They gave you, and

they gave you... I have a lot of stuff that I... from Grunewald that I had. You know, all kind of theory, harmony, and I don't know, all kind of things like that, you know. And you could always refer back to these type of things, but I never did use any of that stuff. And then while I was gone, I went to Professor Hogan. After I left Grunewald School, I went for private lessons over there, and he was teaching me a few things about handling and a little few classical things, you know. And then later on when I got…
